verdict.rationale: Railway documents automatic WebSocket handling and running apps closer to users, but only for deployed services; nothing in the evidence shows edge or serverless functions, let alone WebSockets held open from within them. Container-hosted WebSocket support is an adjacent capability under a different compute model, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps
